test_title: PYST 96: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 10 Jan, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six colleagues A, B, C, D, E and F are having lunch together on a circular table at equal distance, facing the centre of the circle. D is the immediate neighbour of E and B while C is the immediate neighbour of A and F. If A is to the immediate left of E, then who is on the immediate left of C?
solution:
Given: Six colleagues A, B, C, D, E and F are facing the centre of the circle.

1) A is to the immediate left of E.

2) D is the immediate neighbour of E and B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe3b97b857e7199df91d8c1a97c842ed11c42b2e3975b7ec2bd7713e14e6e2e9.png] 

3) C is the immediate neighbour of A and F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/217b44bf059fd7f6c345f156fa0f0a3df5d83248565a1d4e568b27a1c9abb938.png] 

Here, 'F' is on the immediate left of C.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
